entities.name: Corruption of Memnarch
entities.description: The event on Argentum and Mirrodin in which Memnarch was infected by Phyrexian oil and grew corrupt.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A sentient golem entrusted as warden of Argentum, who was corrupted by Phyrexian oil.

entities.name: Argentum
entities.description: The artificial metallic plane created by Karn, later renamed Mirrodin by Memnarch.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The planeswalker who created Argentum. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: The power with which Argentum was infused.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Origin of the black oil that infected Memnarch.

events.summary: Memnarch touches a smear of Phyrexian black oil and becomes infected.
events.quote: Upon touching the oil, Memnarch became infected.

events.summary: Memnarch renames the plane Mirrodin and begins abducting organic beings from across the Multiverse.
Memnarch builds systems of surveillance and control and erases memory.
events.quote: Memnarch built elaborate systems of surveillance and control.

events.summary: Memnarch becomes obsessed with igniting his own Planeswalker spark.
events.quote: Memnarch became obsessed with replicating the conditions that would allow him to ignite his own Planeswalker spark

relations.quote: Created by the Planeswalker Karn as a world of mathematically precise, metallic order

relations.note: Entrusted with the plane as warden.
relations.quote: Argentum was entrusted to the golem Memnarch
